# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Trusted mount-namespace builder for table-driven fixtures (pane 214). Runs
# as uid 0 of a fresh user+mount namespace (unshare --user --map-root-user
# --mount), applies SPEC in order with mount(2), then executes PROGRAM. The
# "check" form applies nothing: it verifies, inside an identically built
# namespace, that every step took effect (setup control).
# SPEC is a JSON list of steps:
#   ["tmpfs", PATH, READONLY]   private tmpfs (size=1m) at PATH, optionally MS_RDONLY
#   ["bind", SOURCE, TARGET]    bind SOURCE over TARGET (file or directory)
#   ["symlink", TARGET, LINK]   create LINK -> TARGET (inside a mounted tmpfs)
#   ["mkdir", PATH]             create a directory (inside a mounted tmpfs)
#   ["shadow", DIR, NAME]       bind DIR to ./shadow-stash, mount a tmpfs over DIR and
#                               relink every entry except NAME (symlinks copied as-is,
#                               others point into the stash), so DIR/NAME is absent
# Usage: ns_build.py SPEC PROGRAM [ARG...] | ns_build.py check SPEC
import ctypes, json, os, sys

MS_RDONLY, MS_REMOUNT, MS_BIND = 1, 32, 4096
lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
STASH = os.path.abspath('shadow-stash')


def mount(source, target, fstype, flags, data):
    if lib.mount(source.encode(), target.encode(), fstype.encode() if fstype else None, ctypes.c_ulong(flags),
                 data.encode() if data else None) != 0:
        print('SETUP-INVALID mount %s on %r: %s' % (fstype or 'bind', target, os.strerror(ctypes.get_errno())))
        sys.exit(97)


def apply(spec):
    for step in spec:
        kind = step[0]
        if kind == 'tmpfs':
            mount('parity-ns', step[1], 'tmpfs', MS_RDONLY if step[2] else 0, 'size=1m,mode=0755')
        elif kind == 'bind':
            mount(step[1], step[2], None, MS_BIND, None)
        elif kind == 'symlink':
            os.symlink(step[1], step[2])
        elif kind == 'mkdir':
            os.mkdir(step[1])
        elif kind == 'shadow':
            os.makedirs(STASH, exist_ok=True)
            mount(step[1], STASH, None, MS_BIND, None)
            names = os.listdir(STASH)
            mount('parity-ns', step[1], 'tmpfs', 0, 'size=1m,mode=0755')
            for name in names:
                if name == step[2]:
                    continue
                held = os.path.join(STASH, name)
                os.symlink(os.readlink(held) if os.path.islink(held) else held, os.path.join(step[1], name))
        else:
            raise AssertionError(kind)


def check(spec):
    for step in spec:
        kind = step[0]
        if kind == 'tmpfs':
            parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(step[1]))
            ok = os.stat(step[1]).st_dev != os.stat(parent).st_dev
            ok = ok and bool(os.statvfs(step[1]).f_flag & os.ST_RDONLY) == bool(step[2])
        elif kind == 'bind':
            with open(step[1], 'rb') as a, open(step[2], 'rb') as b:
                ok = a.read() == b.read()
        elif kind == 'symlink':
            ok = os.readlink(step[2]) == step[1]
        elif kind == 'shadow':
            ok = (not os.path.lexists(os.path.join(step[1], step[2]))
                  and set(os.listdir(step[1])) == set(os.listdir(STASH)) - {step[2]})
        else:
            ok = os.path.isdir(step[1])
        if not ok:
            print('CONTROL-FAILED namespace step %r did not take effect' % (step,))
            sys.exit(98)
    print('namespace control ok')


def main():
    if os.geteuid() != 0:
        print('SETUP-INVALID ns_build.py must run as user-namespace root')
        sys.exit(97)
    if sys.argv[1] == 'check':
        with open(sys.argv[2]) as handle:
            check(json.load(handle))
        return
    with open(sys.argv[1]) as handle:
        apply(json.load(handle))
    os.execv(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[2:])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

cases.purpose: SIGINT delivered to the process group of a sleeping background job (set -m) terminates sleep with the default disposition and wait status 130 while a separately grouped sibling sleep keeps sleeping; with a trapped SIGINT in the job, the trap runs and the job continues, and its reported statuses are compared with GNU sleep.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils 9.7 sleep(1) driven by the identical GNU Bash 5.3.15 job-control script
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr. Readiness is a process of the target group in state S with a sleep/select/poll/hrtimer wchan, read from /proc before any signal (r2 of takeover-a-54: wchan has no trailing newline and is now read with $(<file)); groups are verified from /proc/PID/stat (pgrp == job leader) and the sibling must still be sleeping after delivery. Signals go to the job process group only (kill -- -PGID). Shell job-control diagnostics go to a retained HOME log, so compared stderr is empty on both sides.
cases.script:
exec 2>>"$HOME/shell-stderr.log"
set -m
exec 9<>pace.fifo
pause() { read -r -t 0.02 -u 9 _; return 0; }
stat_fields() { local line; read -r line <"/proc/$1/stat" 2>/dev/null || return 1; printf '%s' "${line##*) }"; }
member_sleeping() {
  local f pid w a
  for f in /proc/[0-9]*/stat; do
    pid=${f#/proc/}; pid=${pid%/stat}
    a=($(stat_fields "$pid")) || continue
    [[ ${a[2]} == "$1" && ${a[0]} == S ]] || continue
    w=$(<"/proc/$pid/wchan") 2>/dev/null || continue
    [[ $w == *sleep* || $w == *select* || $w == *poll* || $w == *hrtimer* ]] && return 0
  done
  return 1
}
await() { local i; for ((i = 0; i < 250; i++)); do member_sleeping "$1" && return 0; pause; done; return 1; }
own_group() { local a; a=($(stat_fields "$1")); [[ ${a[2]} == "$1" ]]; }
printf '[default-int]\n'
sleep 20 &
sib=$!
await "$sib" && printf 'sibling-ready\n' || printf 'sibling-not-ready\n'
sleep 20 &
target=$!
await "$target" && printf 'target-ready\n' || printf 'target-not-ready\n'
own_group "$target" && own_group "$sib" && [[ $target != "$sib" ]] && printf 'separate-groups=yes\n' || printf 'separate-groups=no\n'
builtin kill -INT -- "-$target"
wait "$target"
printf 'target-status=%d\n' "$?"
member_sleeping "$sib" && printf 'sibling-unaffected\n' || printf 'sibling-disturbed\n'
builtin kill -TERM -- "-$sib"
wait "$sib"
printf 'sibling-status=%d\n' "$?"
printf '[trapped]\n'
( trap 'printf "trap-ran\n"' INT; sleep 15; printf 'sleep-returned=%d\n' "$?"; exit 7 ) &
target=$!
await "$target" && printf 'target-ready\n' || printf 'target-not-ready\n'
builtin kill -INT -- "-$target"
wait "$target"
printf 'target-status=%d\n' "$?"
printf 'done\n'

cases.purpose: SIGINT sent only to the tee process while it is blocked reading a private pipe after copying a first line: plain tee terminates (wait status 130, later bytes never copied), tee -i keeps running and copies the later line to both files and stdout, exiting 0 at EOF.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils 9.7 tee(1) driven by the identical GNU Bash 5.3.15 script
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr. The producer writes "first", then blocks on a control FIFO held open by the script; tee is ready when both files hold "first" and its /proc state is S. SIGINT targets the tee PID only (not the job group, so the producer is not signalled); tee liveness is read from /proc 0.5 s later before the producer is released. Output files and the redirected stdout file are printed per run. Shell job-control diagnostics go to a retained HOME log.
cases.script:
exec 2>>"$HOME/shell-stderr.log"
set -m
exec 9<>pace.fifo
pause() { read -r -t 0.02 -u 9 _; return 0; }
stat_fields() { local line; read -r line <"/proc/$1/stat" 2>/dev/null || return 1; printf '%s' "${line##*) }"; }
exec 8<>prod.ctl
state_of() { local a; a=($(stat_fields "$1")) || return 1; printf '%s' "${a[0]}"; }
has_first() { local f l; for f in "$@"; do IFS= read -r l <"$f" 2>/dev/null || return 1; [[ $l == first ]] || return 1; done; }
run() {
  local label=$1 t i st f
  shift
  printf '[%s]\n' "$label"
  : >o1; : >o2; : >o3
  { printf 'first\n'; IFS= read -r _ <prod.ctl; printf 'second\n'; } | tee "$@" o1 o2 >o3 &
  t=$!
  for ((i = 0; i < 250; i++)); do has_first o1 o2 && [[ $(state_of "$t") == S ]] && break; pause; done
  has_first o1 o2 && printf 'copied-first=yes\n' || printf 'copied-first=no\n'
  builtin kill -INT "$t"
  for ((i = 0; i < 25; i++)); do st=$(state_of "$t") || break; [[ $st == Z ]] && break; pause; done
  st=$(state_of "$t") && [[ $st != Z ]] && printf 'tee-after-int=running\n' || printf 'tee-after-int=gone\n'
  printf 'go\n' >&8
  wait "$t"
  printf 'tee-status=%d\n' "$?"
  wait
  for f in o1 o2 o3; do mapfile -t L <"$f"; printf '%s=%s\n' "$f" "${L[*]}"; done
}
run plain
run ignore -i
printf 'done\n'
